body.zh: 维尼已建立覆盖质量管理、医疗器械、化妆品 GMP、生产许可、环境与职业健康安全、社会责任及供应链安全的资质体系，为客户开展供应商评估、产品合规审核和长期项目合作提供清晰、可核验的依据。相关证书及审核资料可联系我们申请获取。
body.en: Vinner maintains a qualification framework covering quality management, medical devices, cosmetics GMP, manufacturing licenses, environmental and occupational health and safety, social responsibility, and supply-chain security. These credentials provide clear, verifiable support for supplier qualification, product compliance reviews, and long-term cooperation. Relevant certificates and audit documents are available upon request.
